default_prompt: You are screening a record for a systematic review of randomized controlled trials on perioperative variables in spine surgery. Read the title and abstract and decide whether the record should be included, applying this review's published eligibility criteria (SYNERGY dataset; original review DOI 10.1097/BRS.0000000000003645): the study must be an RCT with a 1:1 parallel two-arm design; related to spine surgery involving preoperative, intraoperative, or postoperative variables; and have a dichotomous primary or secondary outcome. Exclude studies not involving human subjects, studies with continuous-variable outcomes (e.g. pain scores, Oswestry Disability Index scores, time to union) without predefined clinical success criteria, and studies that did not report a statistically significant primary or secondary outcome measure.
_notes: One of 3 per-review config files (runbook §2, §6) -- vendors/aggregation/tau/
zero_policy/confidence_threshold are identical across all three by design
(the same fixed instrument, screening a different review each run); only
default_prompt differs. See ../README.md for the full history/rationale behind
every other field (tau derivation, model pinning, temperature, zero_policy, the
track_prompts -> default_prompt migration) -- not duplicated here to avoid
three copies going stale independently.

This file is not read literally beyond 'vendors' (including each
vendor's 'temperature'), 'aggregation', 'tau', 'batch_size',
'zero_policy', 'default_prompt', 'track_prompts' (unused here), and
'confidence_threshold' (see attest.cli._load_ensemble_config) -- this
_notes field is ignored by the loader and safe to keep as documentation.
'batch_size' (attest.provenance.config.Config.batch_size, "b_e") is
the number of records attest packs into one screening request, set to
1 here explicitly (rather than left to attest's own fallback default,
also 1) so this checked-in file states outright, not implicitly, that
this pipeline's instrument is one record per request -- on par with
vendors/aggregation/tau, the same fixed instrument shared identically
across all three reviews. Like every other shared field here, it is
hashed into ensemble_config_id; changing it opens a new epoch.
openai/google model pins resolved (2026-08-24): 'gpt-5.6-terra' and
'gemini-3.1-pro-preview', replacing the prior TODO placeholders. See
../README.md's 'vendors (x = 4)' section for why these specific models --
same-level, balanced production-flagship match to claude-sonnet-5/
mistral-large-2512, not each vendor's cheapest or priciest tier -- and a
real risk flag on the Google pin: 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview' has no GA
equivalent yet and its predecessor was deprecated on ~3 weeks' notice --
re-check its availability before freezing a real run.
temperature cleanup across all four vendors (2026-08-24): current-generation
claude-sonnet-5 rejects any explicit temperature/top_p/top_k value (HTTP 400,
confirmed against Anthropic's own current model docs) -- 'send_temperature':
false tells the kernel to omit 'temperature' from the Messages API request
entirely instead of sending a value the vendor rejects outright.
gpt-5.6-terra rejects a non-default temperature unless paired with
'reasoning_effort': 'none' -- confirmed live against this exact review's
default_prompt and a real gold-set record, not assumed from docs. Google's
gemini-3.1-pro-preview technically accepts temperature=0.0 but Google's own
guidance warns it degrades reasoning quality / can cause looping on Gemini
3.x thinking models, so this vendor alone is set to 'temperature': 1.0 (its
own recommended default) rather than forced to match the other three's 0.0.
mistral-large-2512 is unaffected -- not a reasoning-gated model, temperature
0.0 works as a normal parameter. See ../README.md's 'vendors (x = 4)' section
and reviews/README.md's 'vendors (x = 4)'/'temperature' sections for the full
per-vendor rationale. Both new fields are optional, hash-versioned into
ensemble_config_id only when set to something other than their no-op default
(reasoning_effort=None, send_temperature=True), and require attest kernel
commit da977f3 or later.
